title: OAuth Tokens and Session Security Check

questions.prompt: What should a native Android OAuth client use instead of an embedded secret?
questions.explanation: PKCE binds the authorization response without pretending the installed client can hide a secret.

questions.prompt: An ID token should automatically be used as an API bearer token.
questions.explanation: ID tokens describe authentication to a client, while access tokens target resource authorization.

questions.prompt: Which token normally deserves strongest durable protection?
questions.explanation: Its longer lifetime can mint replacement access tokens.
